title: E-mail Surveillance
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael initiates e-mail surveillance at the office with IT support from Sadiq, leading to tension and concern among employees who discover they are being spied on. Meanwhile, Jim organizes a surprise party for Michael, deliberately excluding him to ensure guests can relax. Dwight warns Angela to delete sensitive e-mails, which Pam overhears and finds suspicious. Michael also participates in an improv class, performing a dramatic FBI character, and later joins Jim in a karaoke duet at the office party.

main_threads.thread: Michael's e-mail surveillance causes office tension as employees discover he is spying on their e-mails, leading to concerns about privacy and secretive behavior.
